items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Andy Bey in a list of people who were at the jam sessions ('All the guys were up there'), but the interviewee (Jimmy Cobb) does not respond to confirm a personal relationship or interaction with Andy Bey.

ctx.x: and he also photographed it. Now Duke University’s made a big project out of it, and it sounds like Boogie Woogie’s would be a candidate for a similar kind of treatment.

It would be nice, because his wife – his last wife – is Bertha Hope, and she has all the stuff in her house, probably in her closet. She has a huge amount of this music, which probably is, I don’t know, a lot of people: Andy Bey, Jimmy, as he said, Larry Willis. All the guys were up there.
Did you play with Bertha at all? Bertha Hope at all?
